relief_print.jpg.title: Relief Print
relief_print.jpg.story: I made this with printmaking, using the reduction process and the relief technique on a black and white linoleum sheet. In relief printing, everything I carve away stays white, and everything I leave behind takes the ink.

dragon-1.jpg.title: Dragon, Print 1
dragon-1.jpg.story:
This is a reduction linocut, made with the relief technique on a single linoleum sheet. In a reduction print, I carve away a little of the block, print one colour, then carve away more and print the next colour on top, all from the same sheet. Once a part is carved away, there is no going back, so every layer is final.

All four prints are supposed to be the same, but each one came out with its own texture. That happened because of small shifts in registration, the alignment of the paper with the block between colours. I love that the mistakes made each one unique.
